name: docstack-headless-engine-bundle
description: Real pouchdb-core + @docstack/pouchdb-adapter-native, esbuild-bundled for QuickJS/Zipline. Not a shipped package - engine/build.gradle.kts's zipline-cli step compiles dist/bundle.js to Zipline bytecode, combined with the Kotlin/JS module's own manifest per SPIKE-NOTES.md's manifest-merge technique.
